controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:36:22.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:36:22.000Z"
| WHERE source.ip == "172.18.0.6"
| STATS events = COUNT(*), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY host.name, data_stream.dataset
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 20
